snippet.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358690/Graveyard_Keeper_2/

A satirical trailer for Graveyard Keeper 2 offered a cheeky overview of this 'cosy' life simulator, where you manage a medieval cemetery. It's coming to PC and consoles on September 22.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
